text: The purpose of this report is to provide City Council with the City of Toronto capital spending for the six month period ended June 30, 2021, as well as projected expenditures to December 31, 2021. Furthermore, this report seeks Council's approval for in-year budget adjustments to the 2021 Approved Capital Budget and Plan. As illustrated in Table 1 below, City's 2021 capital expenditure was $1.264 billion or 23.9 percent of the 2021 capital budget of $5.292 billion for the period ended June 30, 2021 and is projecting to expend $4.254 billion or 80.4 percent by December 31, 2021. City Council on October 1 and 4, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve in-year budget adjustments to the 2021-2030 Approved Capital Budget and Plan as detailed in Appendix 4 to the report (September 3, 2021) from the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer.
